lines.text: Moses tells Israel to obey so they may prosper in a land flowing with milk and honey.
Moses says the LORD is One and Israel must love Him with all their heart, soul, and strength.
Israel is to tie these words on their hands and foreheads and write them on their doorposts and gates.
When Israel is satisfied in the land sworn to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, they must not forget the LORD who freed them from Babylon.
Moses tells Israel not to test the LORD as they tested Him at Meribah.
